description: This file defines the AlarmRulesTableConfig class, which extends EntityTableConfig to manage alarm rule entities within the Thingsboard UI. It includes methods for CRUD operations, dialog interactions, debug configurations, and data fetching specific to alarm rules.

classes.name: AlarmRulesTableConfig
classes.description: Class extending EntityTableConfig to manage alarm rule entities, providing functionalities for CRUD operations, dialogs, debug configurations, and data fetching specific to alarm rules within the Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: fetchCalculatedFields
methods.description: Fetches calculated alarm fields, either paginated or by entity ID depending on page mode.

methods.name: onOpenDebugConfig
methods.description: Opens the debug configuration panel for a specific calculated field.

methods.name: editCalculatedField
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit a calculated alarm rule.

methods.name: copyCalculatedField
methods.description: Creates a copy of a calculated alarm rule and opens it in a dialog for editing.

methods.name: getCalculatedAlarmDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for creating or editing a calculated alarm rule.

methods.name: openDebugEventsDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog to view debug events related to a calculated field.

methods.name: openDebugTab
methods.description: Opens the debug tab for a specific calculated field.

methods.name: importCalculatedField
methods.description: Imports a calculated alarm rule from a file.

methods.name: updateImportedCalculatedField
methods.description: Updates the arguments of an imported calculated field to match current tenant context.

methods.name: onDebugConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to debug configuration for a calculated field.

methods.name: getTestScriptDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog to test a calculated field script.

methods.name: openCalculatedField
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a specific alarm rule.

methods.name: onCFAction
methods.description: Handles actions performed on calculated field entities, such as open or export.
